text: Entering this sleek and modern space evokes a mixture of curiosity and anticipation. The glass doors and pristine décor create a sense of formality, while the R+D exhibit inside glows invitingly with vibrant colors and digital displays. Immersed among symbols of research and innovation, I feel inspired and eager to reflect on the intertwining of humanity and technology—how our thinking shapes, and is shaped by, our inventions. The environment stirs both introspective wonder and a slight apprehension at the unknown possibilities that lie ahead.
